summary: Bluerock Homes Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the September 30, 2026 closing of its disposition of Lubbock-75, 75 single-family rental units in Lubbock, Texas, held within the fully owned Peak JV 2 portfolio. The buyer is an unaffiliated third party. Gross sales price was approximately $8.0 million, yielding net proceeds of approximately $7.3 million after closing costs, prorations and adjustments. No board recommendation or advisor is named, and no regulatory clock applies. The filing includes unaudited pro forma condensed consolidated financial statements giving effect to the sale; watch for portfolio-disposition cadence and pricing versus net asset value.
